guideIntro: Meet Rafi. He just moved from Rajshahi to Dhaka for his first job. Follow his journey, and learn the English he needs at each step.

nodes.title: Questions
nodes.story: Day one. Rafi needs to ask where everything is, without sounding rude.

nodes.title: Articles: a, an, the
nodes.story: His manager says: 'You're engineer?' Rafi wants to sound better than that.

nodes.title: Prepositions
nodes.story: Meetings at 10, on Monday, in Gulshan. Rafi must get the small words right.

nodes.title: Nouns and agreement
nodes.story: 'Can I get some informations?' Rafi learns why his colleague smiled.

nodes.title: Tense Lab
nodes.story: Rafi tells his team what he did, what he's doing, and what he'll do.

nodes.title: Modal verbs
nodes.story: Must, should, might: Rafi learns rules, advice and guesses.

nodes.title: Gerunds and infinitives
nodes.story: 'I avoid to be late' or 'I avoid being late'? Rafi finds out.

nodes.title: Passive voice
nodes.story: Reports say 'It was decided…'. Rafi learns why.

nodes.title: Relative clauses and comparisons
nodes.story: The client who called, the plan that works, the best option.

tracks.title: Natural speech
tracks.subtitle: Sound like a native, not a textbook

nodes.title: Phrasal verbs
nodes.story: Colleagues say 'put off', 'figure out', 'catch up'. Rafi wants to follow.

nodes.title: Collocations
nodes.story: Make a decision, not do a decision.

nodes.title: Fillers and discourse
nodes.story: Actually, I mean, anyway: the glue of real conversation.

nodes.title: Linking ideas
nodes.story: On top of that, having said that: Rafi connects his points.

nodes.title: Idioms
nodes.story: 'Let's call it a day.' Rafi finally gets the joke.

nodes.title: Politeness and tone
nodes.story: Rafi's 'Send the file' upset someone. Time to learn tone.

nodes.title: Softening and hedging
nodes.story: 'I was wondering if…' Rafi sounds confident but kind.

nodes.title: Opinions, agreeing, disagreeing
nodes.story: In his first meeting Rafi disagrees, politely.

nodes.title: Plans, invitations, offers
nodes.story: Team lunch on Friday? Rafi invites and accepts.

nodes.title: Complaining and solving problems
nodes.story: The laptop broke. Rafi calls IT.

nodes.title: Telling stories
nodes.story: At the team dinner Rafi tells the story of his village.

nodes.title: Persuading and negotiating
nodes.story: Rafi's first client wants a discount.

nodes.title: Email and chat
nodes.story: Rafi's inbox is full. He writes clear, modern replies.

nodes.title: Small talk and introductions
nodes.story: Lift, tea break, a new colleague: Rafi breaks the ice.

nodes.title: Phone and video calls
nodes.story: 'Can you hear me? You're on mute.'

nodes.title: Job interview
nodes.story: A year later, Rafi interviews for a better job.

nodes.title: Meetings and presentations
nodes.story: Rafi presents the quarterly results.

nodes.title: Customers and clients
nodes.story: An angry customer calls. Rafi stays calm.

nodes.title: Travel: airport and hotel
nodes.story: Rafi's first business trip to Singapore.

nodes.title: Daily life: doctor, bank, shop
nodes.story: Life in Dhaka: bank account, doctor, rent.
